video_title: Doug Christie on Ben Simmons’ Fit with Kings, Their Pace & Lineup Versatility

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: Doug Christie on Ben Simmons' playmaking and defensive versatility
quotes.excerpt: Ben has the ability to push the ball at a really high level, secondary ball-handler and creator.
quotes.quote: Ben has the ability to push the ball at a really high level, secondary ball-handler and creator. It gives everybody space to get out and run, play extremely fast. Not to mention that 6'10" and an all-defensive player, he can guard all five positions.

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: Doug Christie on Keon Ellis's three-point shooting and defensive versatility
quotes.excerpt: Keon obviously brings you three-point shooting and the ability to guard and switch multiple positions as well.
quotes.quote: Keon obviously brings you three-point shooting and the ability to guard and switch multiple positions as well. Very excited to be honest with you that both of them are healthy and playing.

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: Doug Christie on how Ben Simmons' playmaking benefits De'Aaron Fox
quotes.excerpt: He's 6'10" and can push the basketball, which allows De'Aaron Fox to get off the ball.
quotes.quote: He's 6'10" and can push the basketball, which allows De'Aaron Fox to get off the ball. That's a good thing because if they want to pressure him and put a lot of people on him, it allows us to do some other stuff.

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: Doug Christie on the defensive benefits of switching lineups
quotes.excerpt: It helps tremendously when you have the ability sometimes to switch one through five.
quotes.quote: It helps tremendously when you have the ability sometimes to switch one through five. If you get a position out there with Ben, Keon, and De'Aaron, that's just beautiful because you have the ability to switch. But not only switch for switching sake, switch to guys who can switch up, be physical with length and athleticism and keep people in front of them.

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: Doug Christie on Ben Simmons' recovery and return to the court
quotes.excerpt: Everything that you see is Ben. We're here for him, we're going to support him.
quotes.quote: Everything that you see is Ben. We're here for him, we're going to support him, but the credit needs to be given to Ben Simmons because going through being away and all that and coming back is courageous. I'm super excited to see him out there and it just makes me smile.

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: Doug Christie on the challenge of managing player minutes in preseason
quotes.excerpt: It's tough you would like to get more of a game time flow, but this is the league.
quotes.quote: It's tough you would like to get more of a game time flow, but this is the league that we're in and you just have to adjust and figure it out on the fly.

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: Doug Christie on earning playing time and depth
quotes.excerpt: You earn your minutes first and foremost, and some of the guys like Tristan Newton earned his minutes.
quotes.quote: You earn your minutes first and foremost, and some of the guys like Tristan Newton earned his minutes. He played really well. But at the same time, we want to get a look at a lot of different people because that is part of I think our strength will be our depth and our ability to have various lineups.

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: Doug Christie on DeAndre Hunter's shooting and defensive potential
quotes.excerpt: DeAndre brings shooting ability, ability to defend multiple positions.
quotes.quote: DeAndre brings shooting ability, ability to defend multiple positions. This is where you work off the rust. He came here, he only played one game and we're still trying to work him through that, but DeAndre has been great. We know what he can do, he's had flashes of what we expect out of him and the consistency will come with time.

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: Doug Christie on Ben Simmons' versatility as a playmaker
quotes.excerpt: He gives you a cheat sheet because he can beat a screener, are you going to switch?
quotes.quote: He gives you a cheat sheet because he can beat a screener, are you going to switch? He can be the handler, are you going to switch? He can roll into the post and play out of the post, are you going to double because he can make all the passes? It just depends. I don't even call it a problem, it's a really good thing to have in your pocket.
